October 10th is open, and 80 guests fits our standing capacity — though note it's 40 seated/80 standing, so worth confirming which layout you need. On pricing, there's no returning-customer or off-season rate — the weekend options are $260/hour (5-hour minimum) or the full-day buyout at $3,600, both above your $2,400 cap.

The closest fit would be the minimum weekend booking: 5 hours at $260/hour = $1,300, but that's before catering, which runs $35–$65/person in-house (or outside catering with a $200 kitchen fee). For 80 people, food alone would likely exceed your remaining budget, so I want to be upfront that $2,400 all-in isn't realistic for a full wedding with catering here. Want me to connect you with our events manager to see what's possible within a tighter scope?
